# PhoneRecap

> PhoneRecap turns your phone use into a private yearly and monthly story, with cards you can share. Everything stays on your phone.

- Page: https://madhavkwatra.in/phonerecap/
- Platform: Android 10 or newer (in testing on Google Play, not public yet)
- Privacy: no internet permission, no account, no ads, no analytics; data stays on the phone
- Privacy Policy: https://madhavkwatra.in/phonerecap/privacy/
- Made by Madhav Kwatra, an indie developer in India: https://madhavkwatra.in
